mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains depressed while TRANSIT stays below its recent level, weekday shopping trips stay weak and RETAIL_REC will remain lower over the next four weeks than over the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean for four consecutive weeks while WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stay at or below their current levels.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL rises above 4 points, people are spending more time at home; this suppresses discretionary retail visits and pushes RETAIL_REC down within the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases for two straight weekly means after RESIDENTIAL exceeds 4 points and stays elevated.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS signals more neighborhood circulation and local errands, which can spill over into short-horizon retail visits and raise RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within one to two weeks after simultaneous increases in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls by more than 2 points week-on-week, the city is likely seeing a tightening mobility regime that reduces discretionary trips, causing RETAIL_REC to decline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC holds at or above its prior 4-week mean for the next month after a week-on-week TRANSIT drop greater than 2 points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS combined with stable or rising RESIDENTIAL suggests local, non-work leisure substitution rather than downtown shopping, which will keep RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises for four weeks despite PARKS staying elevated and RESIDENTIAL not falling.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM keeps increasing while WORKPLACES is flat or falling, routine errand traffic is shifting away from discretionary shopping and RETAIL_REC will weaken within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within two weeks after GROCERY_PHARM exceeds WORKPLACES by at least 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent upswing in PARKS is a proxy for favorable outdoor conditions; that same seasonal shift should support more shopping and lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its previous four-week average for the next month even as PARKS stays above its recent level.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL drops while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together, the market is in a reopening phase that expands out-of-home activity and raises RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within two weeks when RESIDENTIAL falls and both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES rise together.
